title: Release configuration
description: The release input contract, committed at .github/release-config.yml in every tool repo and read by ci.yml and release.yml. A tag-triggered workflow cannot take dispatch inputs, so this file is the input surface - which also makes every change to it reviewable in a pull request. This schema is for editors and reviewers only: the workflows read the file with yq, and check-release-evidence.mjs reads two keys out of it with a deliberately tiny reader that has no schema support, because it must stay dependency-free. Two rules this schema cannot express are enforced there instead, and both are hard errors: a top-level key declared twice, and a quoted scalar that does not close on its own line.

schema_version.description: Shape of this document. release.yml refuses anything but 1.

tool_slug.description: Must equal the repository name. The join key across repo, landing page and package name; release.yml fails if it does not match.

product_name.description: Display name, used as the GitHub Release title.

artifact_kind.description: What this repo ships. A bare .ps1 script is `mod`: it ships with a minimal .psd1 rather than getting a sixth tag.

artifact_kinds.description: The authoritative release-checklist scope: every applicability tag this repo claims, which is artifact_kind plus `prod` when the tool executes against production directory services, domain controllers or access-control panels. It lives here, in a file reviewed in a pull request, and not only in the evidence file, because a scope that can be narrowed on release day is not a control. The evidence file must restate the same list.

runtime.description: Decides which toolchain is set up, which pin mechanism is checked, and - for `powershell` - which operating system CI runs on. `powershell` routes lint and test to windows-latest under Windows PowerShell 5.1; the release job stays on ubuntu for every runtime.

dist_dir.description: Where the build leaves its artifacts. Defaults to `dist`. Must be a relative path with no leading slash and no .. segment, and its contents must be flat files: a subdirectory fails the build, because the artifacts output, SHA256SUMS and the attestation subject glob must describe the same set. A cross-compiled Go build puts one archive per target at the root, named <slug>_<version>_<os>_<arch>.tar.gz (.zip for windows).

build_command.description: Empty means the repo has already produced dist_dir.

test_command.description: Empty FAILS the release. Release gate 2 has no opt-out.

lint_command.description: Optional. Empty means the runtime linter is skipped with a message; the workflow linter and the secret scan still run.

licence.description: SPDX id. Required when sbom.generator is `psd1`, which writes it into the SBOM. There is no default: per-project licence exceptions are allowed, so a document asserting Apache-2.0 for a repo that is not Apache-2.0 would be worse than a failed build.

generator.description: cyclonedx-gomod runs `cyclonedx-gomod mod`, reading go.mod rather than a built binary - the right shape for a cross-compiled release, where one SBOM describes the module and not one of the per-platform archives.

manual_path.description: Required when generator is `manual`. A relative path with no .. segment.

publish.description: One boolean per channel, plus the optional per-channel parameters the publish jobs need. Every parameter is optional: absent, the workflow derives it and fails with an explicit message naming the key if it cannot.

psgallery_module_name.description: Defaults to the base name of the single .psd1 in the repo.

psgallery_module_path.description: A DIRECTORY, not the .psd1 file itself: the job builds <path>/<module_name>.psd1 and hands the directory to Publish-PSResource -Path, which takes a module folder. Defaults to the directory holding the single .psd1.

winget_package_id.description: Publisher.PackageName. Required when winget is enabled; winget accepts only .exe and MSI installers, so the job also refuses to run unless artifact_kind is `bin`.

elgato_pack.description: Packs and attaches the .streamDeckPlugin; the Marketplace submission stays a manual Maker Console step.

claude_skill_dir.description: Defaults to the directory holding the single SKILL.md.

then.description: The psd1 SBOM generator writes the licence into the document a procurement reviewer reads, so it must be stated rather than assumed.
